title: Theming & UI primitives
description: Design tokens, Fraunces/DM Sans pairing, light/dark theming, and the UI kit every screen builds on — including DataTable, Dialog, Sheet, Toast, Select, MediaImage, and onboarding.

pack.description: Colour palette used by the generated app.

notes: Screens must not hard-code colours, spacing, radii or font sizes — read them from the theme.
Prefer List/Grid (`@legendapp/list`) over raw FlatList for scrolling collections.

Prefer DataTable for admin/resource lists (column grid on desktop, stacked rows on phone). DataTable ships a freeform `q` filter, optional `filterable` columns, and drag-to-resize rows/columns. SplitView can `collapsible` the detail pane.
Sheet is a bottom sheet on phone and an anchored popup menu on desktop. Select and DataTable filter pickers use it.
Use AppHeader, SplitView, FeedLayout, CatalogLayout, MapListSplit, ReaderLayout, and MediaDetail for desktop vs phone layout — do not left-align a 720px column in an empty pane.
Appearance preference is persisted with react-native-mmkv v4 (requires react-native-nitro-modules and a development build).
Use useResponsive() for breakpoint-aware layout (desktop chrome at lg / ≥992px).
Inside app chrome, Screen/List default to the pane (width=full). Use feed/reader/form with FeedLayout, ReaderLayout, or auth screens. Pass align="center" on standalone forms.
Switch palette with `radiance add theme --pack contrast` or by editing lib/theme/config.ts.
Custom packs from init land in lib/theme/packs/custom.ts and register via radiance:theme-packs markers.
